job_description: Job RequirementsJob Title: Back Office Executive Jobs in Balaji Motors - Patna, BiharLocation: Patna, Bihar, IndiaSalary: ₹16,500 - ₹25,000 per monthQualification: 10th Standard / SSLCWork Experience: Freshers are welcome to applyJob DescriptionAre you ready to advance your career with a reputable company? Balaji Motors in Patna, Bihar, is actively seeking dedicated individuals for the position of Back Office Executive. As a vital part of our team, you will be responsible for various administrative and support functions that ensure our operations run smoothly. If you are detail-oriented, reliable, and eager to contribute to the success of Balaji Motors, we encourage you to apply. This role offers a competitive salary range of ₹16,500 - ₹25,000 per month and additional benefits including Fuel and Phone Allowances.Key ResponsibilitiesData Entry and Management: Accurately enter and manage data to support the efficient operations of Balaji Motors.Document Handling: Process and verify documents, ensuring all records are accurate and up-to-date.Administrative Support: Provide essential back office support, including filing and report generation.Customer Assistance: Handle backend customer interactions, addressing queries and providing necessary support.Inventory Tracking: Monitor and update inventory records, coordinating with relevant departments for accuracy.Office Coordination: Assist in streamlining office processes and improving operational efficiency.Report Preparation: Generate and maintain operational reports to support business decisions.System Updates: Regularly update office systems and databases with current information.Compliance Checks: Ensure all documentation adheres to company policies and regulatory requirements.Task Management: Prioritize and manage tasks effectively to meet deadlines and support Balaji Motors operations.RequirementsEducational Qualification: Minimum of 10th Standard / SSLC.Experience: Freshers are welcome; prior experience in a similar role is advantageous.Skills: Basic English language skills for effective communication and documentation.Identification: Possess Aadhaar Card, Education Proof, PAN Card, and other necessary documents.Attention to Detail: Must have a keen eye for detail to ensure accuracy in data entry and document handling.Organizational Skills: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks efficiently.Computer Proficiency: Basic computer skills and familiarity with data management tools.Work Ethic: A dedicated and proactive approach to supporting the team at Balaji Motors.BenefitsCompetitive Salary: Earn a salary ranging from ₹16,500 - ₹25,000 per month at Balaji Motors, reflecting the value of your role.Day Shift Schedule: Enjoy a full-time position with a day shift, allowing for a balanced work-life routine.Allowances: Receive additional benefits, including Fuel and Phone Allowances to assist with daily expenses.Career Growth: Join Balaji Motors for a rewarding career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.If you are enthusiastic about contributing to Balaji Motors and are looking for a dynamic work environment, apply now to start your journey with us!FAQ's1Q: What is the salary range for this position?A: The salary ranges from ₹16,500 to ₹25,000 per month.2Q: What are the working days and hours?A: This is a full-time position with a day shift schedule, and you will be working 6 days a week.3Q: What qualifications are required?A: We welcome candidates with a minimum of a 10th Standard / SSLC education, including freshers. Basic English language skills are necessary.4Q: Are there any additional benefits?A: Yes, in addition to the salary, we offer Fuel Allowance and Phone Allowance.5Q: What documents are required?A: Candidates must provide their Aadhaar Card, Education Proof, PAN Card, and any other necessary documents.
